sections.title: Goddess Cubes
sections.note: 27 cubes on the surface, each opening one Goddess Chest in the Sky. Strike, then open.

items.name: Deep Woods: Gorko's cube
items.howTo: Cube: After the tightropes in the Deep Woods, Gorko is studying this cube. Chest: Pumpkin Landing.
items.notes: HD: the Zelda & Loftwing amiibo can take you straight back to the Sky to open chests.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: After the tightropes in the Deep Woods, Gorko is studying this cube. Hit it with a Skyward Strike; it's the first cube, so Gorko explains how they work.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: Just outside the front door of the Lumpy Pumpkin, on Pumpkin Landing.

items.name: Deep Woods: by the Skyview Temple entrance
items.howTo: Cube: Just outside the entrance to the Skyview Temple. Chest: island by the Faron pillar.
items.notes: The chest holds a Piece of Heart (also listed in Heart Pieces).

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Just outside the entrance to the Skyview Temple. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the small island closest to the Faron pillar of light, near Pumpkin Landing.

items.name: Skyview Spring
items.howTo: Cube: In the Skyview Spring at the end of the Skyview Temple: drop into the water and go behind the goddess statue's platform. Chest: Lumpy Pumpkin roof.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: In the Skyview Spring at the end of the Skyview Temple: drop into the water and go behind the goddess statue's platform. If you missed it, go back through the temple and the boss room. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the canvas roof above the Lumpy Pumpkin's front door. Dive off your Loftwing and steer onto it.

items.name: Eldin Volcano entrance
items.area: Near the Volcano Entry Bird Statue
items.howTo: Cube: Right at the start of Eldin Volcano: walk forward, take the first left and drop to the lower ledge. Chest: island north-west of Fun Fun Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Right at the start of Eldin Volcano: walk forward, take the first left and drop to the lower ledge. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the upper part of the triple island just north-west of Fun Fun Island, in the south-west Sky.

items.name: Volcano East three-way split
items.area: Past the Volcano East Bird Statue
items.howTo: Cube: After the Mogma who teaches you about Bomb Flowers, go past the Bird Statue to where the path splits three ways and go straight ahead. Chest: island next to Bamboo Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: After the Mogma who teaches you about Bomb Flowers, go past the Bird Statue to where the path splits three ways and go straight ahead. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the upper part of the island between Beedle's Island and Bamboo Island.

items.name: Pillar inside the small volcano
items.howTo: Cube: Jump down into the small volcano and steer your fall: the cube is on a pillar to the right. Chest: outside the Isle of Songs.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Jump down into the small volcano and steer your fall: the cube is on a pillar to the right. Open the Sailcloth over it to land. If you miss, take the updraft at the north exit and try again. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the right side of the lower rim of the Isle of Songs, in the Thunderhead. The chest can only be reached once the Thunderhead opens (Light Tower raised).

items.name: West of the Earth Temple entrance
items.howTo: Cube: West of the Earth Temple entrance, dig the soft soil: one spot uncovers an updraft. Chest: Bamboo Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: West of the Earth Temple entrance, dig the soft soil: one spot uncovers an updraft. Throw a Bomb Flower up it to blow up the boulder hiding the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: Behind the building on Bamboo Island, north-east of Skyloft.

items.name: East of the Earth Temple entrance
items.howTo: Cube: East of the Earth Temple entrance, past the Bokoblins and their huts, a ramp leads down to the cube. Chest: caged chest near Beedle's Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: East of the Earth Temple entrance, past the Bokoblins and their huts, a ramp leads down to the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the small island south-east of Beedle's Island, in the north-east Sky: land on its upper part and climb down the vines to the chest behind the gate.

items.name: Below the sand slide
items.howTo: Cube: Slide down the big sand slide in the north-east and ride the left updraft to a higher platform. Chest: Skyloft shed.
items.notes: The chest holds a Piece of Heart (also listed in Heart Pieces). Opening the chest needs: Water Dragon's Scale.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Slide down the big sand slide in the north-east and ride the left updraft to a higher platform. The cube is on a lower platform just in front of it; drop down to strike it. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: In the shed in Skyloft reached by swimming through the underwater passage at the base of the windmill. The chest can only be reached once Water Dragon's Scale.

items.name: Lanayru Mine entrance
items.howTo: Cube: At the start of the Lanayru Mine, where the Bird Statue is, go to the far south. Chest: bombable wall near Beedle's Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: At the start of the Lanayru Mine, where the Bird Statue is, go to the far south. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the island south-east of Beedle's Island: drop to its lower part and bomb the rocky wall.

items.name: South-west desert sands
items.howTo: Cube: In the sandy south-west of the desert, knock out an Ampilus with a bomb and stand on its shell to get your stamina back, then dash across the sand to the cube. Chest: outside the volcanic island.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon drops the bomb with the Hook Beetle.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: In the sandy south-west of the desert, knock out an Ampilus with a bomb and stand on its shell to get your stamina back, then dash across the sand to the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the outer ledge of the crater-shaped island just east of the Lanayru pillar of light.

items.name: Temple of Time mine cart
items.howTo: Cube: At the north-west of the Temple of Time, hit the Timeshift Stone to power the mine cart, ride it across the gap and Skyward Strike the cube as you pass. Chest: Beedle's Island.
items.notes: The chest holds a Piece of Heart (also listed in Heart Pieces).

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: At the north-west of the Temple of Time, hit the Timeshift Stone to power the mine cart, ride it across the gap and Skyward Strike the cube as you pass. If you miss, ride again.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On top of Beedle's Island, just above Beedle's hut.

items.name: Great Tree: west side
items.area: Outside the Great Tree, west side
items.howTo: Cube: Swim into the Great Tree and climb out of the top exit. Chest: Skyloft, south of the Knight Academy.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Swim into the Great Tree and climb out of the top exit. Look down: the cube is below on the west side of the tree. Drop down to it. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the small floating island just south of the Knight Academy. Glide to it from the diving platform nearby.

items.name: Great Tree: south-east ledge
items.area: Outside the Great Tree, south-east side
items.howTo: Cube: From the top of the Great Tree, walk anticlockwise round the outside to the south-east. Chest: inside the volcanic island.
items.notes: The chest holds a Piece of Heart (also listed in Heart Pieces).

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: From the top of the Great Tree, walk anticlockwise round the outside to the south-east. Drop to the ledge with the cube below, opening the Sailcloth to land. Later, the Clawshots get you there too. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On a high ledge inside the crater-shaped island east of the Lanayru pillar of light. Skydive onto it or clawshot up.

items.name: Great Tree: tightrope ledge
items.area: Outside the Great Tree, near the top
items.howTo: Cube: Near the top of the Great Tree, where you met the Kikwi, hang off the ledge just south of the part facing the viewing platform. Chest: Thunderhead island north-east of the Isle of Songs.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Near the top of the Great Tree, where you met the Kikwi, hang off the ledge just south of the part facing the viewing platform. Drop to the platform below and cross the tightrope to the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the island north-east of the Isle of Songs, in the Thunderhead. Kill the Walltulas on the vines and climb up to the chest. The chest can only be reached once the Thunderhead opens (Light Tower raised).

items.name: Lake Floria: behind the Bird Statue
items.area: Cavern by the Lake Floria Bird Statue
items.howTo: Cube: At the Lake Floria Bird Statue on the surface, turn round and walk to the back of the cavern. Chest: Skyloft floating island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: At the Lake Floria Bird Statue on the surface, turn round and walk to the back of the cavern. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On a small island among Skyloft's floating islands: clawshot up to the big waterfall island, dive off its far side and glide down to the chest.

items.name: North-east desert passage
items.howTo: Cube: Bomb the cracked wall in the north-east of the desert and follow the narrow corridor. Chest: underwater, island next to Bamboo Island.
items.notes: Opening the chest needs: Water Dragon's Scale.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Bomb the cracked wall in the north-east of the desert and follow the narrow corridor. Clawshot along the targets to the cube at the end. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the island west of Beedle's Island: land on its lower part, dive into the water and swim into the cave; a water dash gets you up to the chest.

items.name: South-west of the Mining Facility
items.area: High platform near the caged robot
items.howTo: Cube: Just south-west of the Lanayru Mining Facility, clawshot up to the higher platforms. Chest: island north-west of Fun Fun Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Just south-west of the Lanayru Mining Facility, clawshot up to the higher platforms. The cube is on one of them. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: At the bottom of the small triple island north-west of Fun Fun Island: land where you opened the earlier chest and climb down the vines.

items.name: Ancient Harbour
items.howTo: Cube: At the north end of the harbour where you first met Skipper, clawshot from a box into the northern cavern. Chest: Skyloft, behind Gondo's Scrap Shop.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: At the north end of the harbour where you first met Skipper, clawshot from a box into the northern cavern. Watch for the Arachas on the ceiling. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: In the storage area behind Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar.

items.name: Skipper's Retreat pillar
items.howTo: Cube: Past the bridge with the Moblin, where a Quadro Baba waits, look left for a pillar with vines. Chest: caged chest north-west of Fun Fun Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Past the bridge with the Moblin, where a Quadro Baba waits, look left for a pillar with vines. Clawshot to it, climb round to the left, then clawshot to the pillar with the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the triple island north-west of Fun Fun Island: land on the smaller platform, clawshot to the vines above the gate and drop down to the chest.

items.name: Above the Pirate Stronghold door
items.howTo: Cube: After the Pirate Stronghold, turn round as you come out: clawshot to the target above the door, then to the next one, up to the platform with the cube. Chest: top of Skyloft's waterfall.
items.notes: The chest holds a Piece of Heart (also listed in Heart Pieces). Opening the chest needs: Clawshots.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: After the Pirate Stronghold, turn round as you come out: clawshot to the target above the door, then to the next one, up to the platform with the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: At the top of the waterfall island in Skyloft: clawshot to the vines on the floating rock outside the Waterfall Cave, then up to the top.

items.name: On top of the Skyview Temple
items.howTo: Cube: Walk to the right of the Skyview Temple entrance and clawshot to the vines to climb onto the roof. Chest: Beedle's Island at night.
items.notes: The chest can only be opened at night.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Walk to the right of the Skyview Temple entrance and clawshot to the vines to climb onto the roof. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: Inside Beedle's hut on Beedle's Island at night. Sleep in the bed at the back of Beedle's Airshop to wake on his island at night, then climb the ladder into the hut.

items.name: Outside the Ancient Cistern
items.howTo: Cube: Facing the path to the Water Dragon outside the Ancient Cistern, look up and slightly left for hanging vines. Chest: under Fun Fun Island.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Facing the path to the Water Dragon outside the Ancient Cistern, look up and slightly left for hanging vines. Clawshot over to the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On a small island beneath Fun Fun Island.

items.name: Volcano Summit waterfall
items.howTo: Cube: In the Volcano Summit waterfall area, run off the diving ledge and glide forward. Chest: Bug Rock.
items.notes: The chest holds a Piece of Heart (also listed in Heart Pieces).

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: In the Volcano Summit waterfall area, run off the diving ledge and glide forward. A lower platform behind a pillar comes into view: land on it with the Sailcloth. Climb the vines to get back. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On a wooden ledge on the south-west of Bug Rock, in the Thunderhead: drop to it from the castle-like overhang at the top, and clawshot the vines to leave.

items.name: Near the Fire Sanctuary entrance
items.howTo: Cube: Facing the Fire Sanctuary entrance, turn left and climb out of the window ahead. Chest: top of the Isle of Songs.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: Facing the Fire Sanctuary entrance, turn left and climb out of the window ahead. Clawshot along the pillars to the cube. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: Right on top of the main tower of the Isle of Songs.

items.name: Volcano Summit: by Eldin's lair
items.area: South-east platform near the Fire Dragon
items.howTo: Cube: When you come back to the Volcano Summit for the Song of the Hero, the cube is in the room just to the right as you enter. Chest: first chest, Mogma Mitts island.
items.after: Eldin's part of the Song of the Hero
items.notes: Opening the chest needs: Mogma Mitts. With the True Master Sword's long-range Skyward Strike you can reach it from solid ground. In Hero Mode the long range is there from the start.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: When you come back to the Volcano Summit for the Song of the Hero, the cube is in the room just to the right as you enter. Ride a floating platform close enough to Skyward Strike it.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the island south-west of the Isle of Songs, in the Thunderhead: dig into the hole with the Mogma Mitts, get past the Moldorm, come out of the lower hole and climb the vines.

items.name: Lanayru Gorge
items.howTo: Cube: In the north-east of Lanayru Gorge, right by the spot where you plant the Life Tree Seedling. Chest: second chest, Mogma Mitts island.
items.after: Lanayru's part of the Song of the Hero
items.notes: Opening the chest needs: Mogma Mitts.

tiers.name: Cube struck
tiers.howTo: In the north-east of Lanayru Gorge, right by the spot where you plant the Life Tree Seedling. Raise your sword until it glows, then swing to send a Skyward Strike into the cube.

tiers.name: Chest opened
tiers.howTo: On the same island south-west of the Isle of Songs: dig in with the Mogma Mitts, get past the Moldorm and come out of the upper hole.
